note: Natrona County campground on the east side of Alcova Reservoir, the first one reached on County Road 407 (Kortes Road). Most sites have a shade shelter, and several sit right on the shore (09, 12, 14, 15, 17); restrooms, two boat ramps and a large group shelter. --Claude
